GRP-01.title: Nightly Cerner ADT load failed → bed census & ED reports stale
GRP-01.root_cause: Talend job CERNER_ADT_DAILY failed at 02:14 on a Redshift connection timeout and both retries failed. Every downstream bed/ED report is showing yesterday's data.
GRP-01.recommended_action: Fix and re-run CERNER_ADT_DAILY once, close the 3 monitoring alerts as children, and send one status update to the 3 affected report users.
GRP-01.comms_draft:
Subject: Bed census & ED boarding reports delayed this morning

Hi all — the overnight load that feeds the Bed Census, Bed Availability and ED Boarding reports failed at 2:14 AM. Data Engineering is re-running it now; we expect reports to show today's numbers by 10:30 AM. You don't need to open a new ticket — we've linked yours to INC0104511 and will update you here when it's done.

— Data Engineering On-Call

GRP-02.title: Redshift queries timing out (WLM queue saturated)
GRP-02.root_cause: CloudWatch shows the default WLM queue waiting >300s since ~3 PM yesterday. A long-running ad-hoc research query is holding most of the slots.
GRP-02.recommended_action: Kill / move the long-running query to a research WLM queue, then confirm the Tableau extract refresh succeeds. Link the 3 user tickets to the alarm.
GRP-02.comms_draft:
Subject: Redshift slowness — cause found

Hi — the slowdowns and timeouts you reported are caused by one long-running query that's tying up shared capacity. We're moving it to a separate queue now; queries and Tableau refreshes should return to normal within the hour. Your ticket is linked to INC0104490.

— Data Engineering

GRP-03.title: Access requests for the Bed Capacity Tableau dashboard
GRP-03.root_cause: Five managers emailed the help desk for dashboard access, which auto-opened Incidents. These are access requests, not outages.
GRP-03.recommended_action: Convert all 5 to a single access Request (RITM), approve against the Bed Capacity AD group, and close the Incidents before they breach SLA.
GRP-03.comms_draft:
Subject: Your Bed Capacity dashboard access

Hi — thanks for reaching out. Your note came in as an incident, so we've converted it to an access request to get it approved faster. Once your manager approves (usually same day), you'll be able to open the dashboard. For next time, the 'Request Tableau Access' form in the portal goes straight to the right team.

— Data Engineering

GRP-04.title: Lab results ingestion Lambda timing out
GRP-04.root_cause: lab-results-ingest Lambda hit its 900s limit twice; S3 landing prefix shows ~3x normal object count, likely a vendor backfill dump.
GRP-04.recommended_action: Confirm the vendor backfill, raise Lambda concurrency / batch size temporarily, and treat the 3 alerts as one incident.
GRP-04.comms_draft:
Subject: Lab results feed running behind

Hi — the lab results feed into the warehouse is behind because of a large vendor file drop overnight. We're processing it now; lab-based reports may be up to 4 hours behind until about noon.

— Data Engineering

GRP-05.title: OMOP vocabulary is out of date
GRP-05.root_cause: The OMOP concept tables are on the March vocabulary release; newer SNOMED codes are missing, which is what the researcher is seeing.
GRP-05.recommended_action: Fulfil RITM0031207 (load latest Athena vocabulary) and close INC0104505 as resolved-by-request.
GRP-05.comms_draft:
Subject: Missing SNOMED codes in OMOP

Hi — the missing codes are because our OMOP vocabulary is due for a refresh. That's already requested under RITM0031207 and scheduled for this sprint; we've linked your ticket to it.

— Data Engineering

GRP-06.title: Login / password issues sent to Data Engineering
GRP-06.root_cause: Account lockout and password-expiry tickets that belong to the IT Service Desk, not Data Engineering.
GRP-06.recommended_action: Reassign both to the IT Service Desk queue immediately.
GRP-06.comms_draft:
Subject: Your login issue

Hi — login and password problems are handled by the IT Service Desk, so we've moved your ticket there. They'll reach out shortly. If it's urgent, call the Service Desk line.

— Data Engineering
